notes: The new heroes' first relationships (2026-10-23): Thresh's bomber wing, Gale's Cutlasses, Mask and his Pawns, Rumor the spy. Merged by tools/author_bonds_v1.py like the sky pairs.

motifs: the bomber the saint was built to stop

C.title: What she was built for
beats: Kettle has a Hailstorm silhouette chalked inside the Archangel's hatch. It predates Thresh.
And I come from below. That's what they built me for. You.
Then we'll get on. Nobody else takes me seriously.

B.title: Practice runs
beats: Thresh flies dummy runs over the camp. Kettle tracks every one and fires at none.
Third pass. I had you on all three.
I know. I wanted to know what it feels like to be had.
Honest. Nobody's ever been honest with me at that altitude.

A.title: The only sky I trust
beats: Enemy anti-air lit up the whole valley. The Hailstorm flew home through the one corridor Kettle had cleared.
If anyone shoots you down, it'll be me. I'm not sharing.
That's the kindest threat I've ever had.

motifs: the house knocks, the sky knocks

C.title: Two kinds of knocking
beats: Fatboy and Thresh compare craters like other people compare scars.

B.title: The same wall
beats: They hit the same wall on the same sortie. Neither will say who finished it.

A.title: Weather and house
beats: One plodding house, one bomber, and an enemy citadel that stopped being a citadel.
Never looked down. I think that makes us family.

motifs: the ford and the wing over it

C.title: Floating
beats: Six Cutlasses sit on the river like a flock of ducks. Anvil's Turtles wade past them.
The river doesn't notice mine. That's the trick.

B.title: Flood season
beats: When the waterline rose over Koom, the two of them were the only ones smiling.
Everyone else sees a flood. I see a runway.

A.title: Amphibious
beats: The Turtles took the ford while the Cutlasses held the sky over it. The enemy had planned for a dry bed.

motifs: the spare king and the left hand

C.title: Left of whom
beats: Mask's Pawns salute him. Pavise watches and says nothing for a long time.
I still walk your left. The real one's.
The spare doesn't get a salute.

B.title: Drawing fire
beats: The enemy spent half its artillery on Mask. Pavise noticed who that saved.
They think I'm you. Or you're me. I lose track.
You drew fire meant for the company.
It's what I was built for. I'm just doing it on purpose now.

A.title: Two crowns
beats: Pavise has started walking on Mask's left, too, when the Pawns can see.
I walk the left of whoever they're aiming at. Today it's you.

C.title: Accounts
beats: The Auditor has a column for every unit the company owns. Rumor keeps adding rows.
Ledger with legs. Where did these four tanks come from?
Not in my books it doesn't. Not without a receipt.

B.title: Receipts
beats: Rumor now leaves a scrap of paper on every captured unit. It says 'paid'.

A.title: Balanced
beats: The books balanced this sortie, for the first time since Rumor arrived.
You captured exactly what we lost.
I read your ledger. I hate leaving you a deficit.

C.title: Payroll
beats: Veil's jammers hide everything. Rumor seems to be inside the fog before it rolls in.

B.title: Cover
beats: The Ghosts walk into the enemy base inside Veil's blind spot, and walk out with a factory.
They never saw you. I was just standing in it.

A.title: Nobody
beats: An entire enemy patrol changed sides without a shot, and nobody on either team can say how.
